root_cause.description: bm-sticky-bar.liquid script is an inline <script> (no defer) that runs before main-product section is parsed. At run time, .product-form__buttons does not exist in DOM → querySelector returns null → if (!target) return exits early → IntersectionObserver NEVER created → aria-hidden stays 'true' forever → sticky permanently hidden.

evidence.script_type: plain <script> — no defer, no module, no async

ruled_out: z-index conflict — no higher-z element found blocking sticky
CSS conflict — live bm-store-main-overrides.liquid has no #bm-sticky-bar CSS (comment confirms removed)
duplicate id=bm-sticky-bar — only 1 instance in live HTML
iOS safe-area — minor cosmetic, not functional failure
viewport too short — would cause 'never shows on short pages', not 'never shows on any page'
IntersectionObserver browser support — IO is present in HTML, just never invoked
affected_scope: ALL products using templates where bm_sticky_bar section appears BEFORE main section in order array

option_a.name: DOMContentLoaded + readyState fix
option_a.description: Wrap IntersectionObserver setup in initStickyObserver(). Call immediately if readyState != 'loading', else wait for DOMContentLoaded.
option_a.code: function initStickyObserver() { var target = document.querySelector('.product-form__buttons') || document.querySelector('.product-form__submit:not(#bm-sticky-add-btn)'); if (!target) return; new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) { var vis = entries[0].isIntersecting; bar.setAttribute('aria-hidden', vis ? 'true' : 'false'); }, { threshold: 0.1 }).observe(target); } if (document.readyState === 'loading') { document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initStickyObserver); } else { initStickyObserver(); }

option_b.name: Always show after scroll (mobile only)
option_b.description: window.scroll listener, show sticky when scrollY > 250. Mobile only (max-width 768px). Simpler but less precise.
option_b.note: Shows sticky even when ATC button still visible — less accurate UX

css_analysis.ios_safe_area: not implemented — minor cosmetic gap on iPhone with home indicator

observer_analysis.threshold_note: threshold:0 only shows sticky when target COMPLETELY off viewport. threshold:0.1 recommended for better UX
observer_analysis.reason: early return before new IntersectionObserver() call
